summary: Add opt-in, content-free st-chatgpt per-call outcome, latency, exact response byte count and daemon request correlation evidence. Refs #3336, #2172, #3257.

replay.detail: No stored data or replay changes.

schema.detail: No published client or MCP schema change.

rules.detail: No grant, authorization or write admission changes.

compatibility.detail: Tool responses are unchanged. Logs allow only closed tool names, adapter codes, timing, bytes and validated daemon request UUIDs.

downtime.detail: No migration or service activation required by the code change.

manual.detail: Capture is off by default. Set RUST_LOG=st_chatgpt::call=info on the adapter to emit structured completion records to stderr. Daemon tracing must be enabled separately for server joins. Real browser read/send correlation remains rollout acceptance; no permission widening or new production write probes are authorized.

recovery.detail: Unset the diagnostic filter to stop capture; no durable state changes.
